rule: A bound on B_readout*tau_clock_time is not a bound on B_readout unless tau_clock_time has a parent-owned nonzero normalization.
The observed-coframe clock zero branch is clock-sector only; it does not automatically prove R10, WEP, material, PPN or orbital readout tails are zero.
The tau/reference map must be selected before residual comparison; fitting it after seeing clock, orbital, R10 or PPN residuals is scored as a residual, not erased.
